Name: Close the Net
Card text: Attack an enemy adjacent to at least three of my allies. Reward: 1 VP and 1 tactic.
Digital implementation notes: Attacker counts if adjacent. Next-own-turn eligibility; attack must reach dice, not hit; one claim/turn, no reshuffle.

Name: Break the Levy
Card text: Attack two different enemy Recruits in one turn. Reward: 1 VP and 1 tactic.
Digital implementation notes: Distinct IDs; reset each turn. Next-own-turn eligibility; attack must reach dice, not hit; one claim/turn, no reshuffle.

Name: Into the Teeth
Card text: Attack an enemy with a hero adjacent to at least two enemies. Reward: 1 VP and 1 tactic.
Digital implementation notes: Check attacking hero adjacency before dice. Next-own-turn eligibility; attack must reach dice, not hit; one claim/turn, no reshuffle.

Name: Pin Them Down
Card text: End my turn with three friendly Recruits adjacent to the same enemy. Reward: 1 VP and 1 tactic.
Digital implementation notes: Living units at claim checkpoint. Next-own-turn eligibility; attack must reach dice, not hit; one claim/turn, no reshuffle.

Name: At Their Gates
Card text: End my turn with at least two friendly units adjacent to the enemy spawn area. Reward: 1 VP and 1 tactic.
Digital implementation notes: Distinct units outside but adjacent to scenario spawn area. Next-own-turn eligibility; attack must reach dice, not hit; one claim/turn, no reshuffle.

Name: Claim the Starfall
Card text: End my turn with all my heroes occupying printed X locations. Reward: 1 VP and 1 tactic.
Digital implementation notes: All selected heroes alive/on-board; 3 normally, 4 team TEST. Xs persist. Next-own-turn eligibility; attack must reach dice, not hit; one claim/turn, no reshuffle.
